limits.timeout_scope: whole child process: input, preprocessing, initialization, SGD, stress evaluation and output
limits.measurement_policy: sequential; one warmup per graph/method/pivots/tile setting; successful runs only; failed warmup blocks formal seeds with explicit unexecuted records
limits.rationale: Apple M4 Pro 24 GiB unified RAM. Pilot 60 s stopped web-Stanford RR after 15 SGD iterations had completed; doubled process wall limit before formal runs. RSS cap reserves memory for macOS and analysis. Resource-censored results are missing, never 0/1 speedup.
limits.artifact_policy: Buffered native text exports; after the child exits, text and f64 checkpoints are losslessly gzip level1 archived with CRC and SHA verification outside native timing. Initial interrupted 662 conditions excluded.
